name: Bentouya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood bento shop (Yutaka Bentou): an opening-time change notice, a first day working part-time, a home-delivery guide, an online reservation notice, an allergy and point-card usage guide, a lesson in rephrasing a technical freshness term simply, teaching a junior the lid-and-temperature order for checking a delivery box, the shop's history of switching from paper order slips to a tablet system, a weekly meal-plan subscription guide, a column on the discussion behind a local-ingredient open-kitchen event, a hybrid stamp-card-plus-app allergy-check membership guide, a reflection on balancing speed and conversation with customers, and a one-year anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
